<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2003|month=07|day=24|content=
* The United States' provisional authority in [[Iraq]] releases photos of what are presumably the dead bodies of [[Uday Hussein|Uday]] and [[Qusay Hussein]] in an attempt to show the Iraqi people proof that the two were actually killed in a U.S. military operation.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cnn.com/2003/WORLD/meast/07/24/sprj.irq.sons/index.html|title=CNN.com - U.S. releases photos said to show Saddam's sons' bodies - Jul. 24, 2003|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* [[California]] lieutenant governor [[Cruz Bustamante]] announces that governor [[Gray Davis]] will face a recall election on October 7. This will be the second gubernatorial recall election in the United States history (the first occurred 82 years beforehand).<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.sacbee.com/content/politics/story/7091491p-8039220c.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050415210317/http://www.sacbee.com/content/politics/story/7091491p-8039220c.html |archive-date=2005-04-15 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* Italian officials have decided to attempt a restoration of [[Michelangelo Buonarroti|Michelangelo]]'s ''[[Michelangelo's David|David]]'' using distilled water.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.cbc.ca/artsCanada/stories/davidbath240703 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041207030438/http://www.cbc.ca/artsCanada/stories/davidbath240703 |archive-date=2004-12-07 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[Colin R. McMillan]], President [[George W. Bush|Bush]]'s nominee for the post of [[United States Secretary of the Navy]], dies of an apparently self-inflicted gunshot wound to the head.
* ''[[Jueves negro]]:'' Violent rioting follows on from political demonstrations in [[Guatemala City]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/americas/3094857.stm (BBC)]
